# html-html-to-apk-

> Browser-based tool to pack HTML, CSS, and JS files into a signed Android APK directly in the browser without external libraries or backend servers. Includes full Termux-compatible source code for building custom base APK templates.

## Project Overview

This repository provides a zero-dependency web application (`index.html`) that unpacks a pre-built template APK (`template.apk`), injects user web assets into `assets/www/`, patches the binary `AndroidManifest.xml` (AXML) to update the app label, replaces the launcher icon, and cryptographically signs the resulting archive using JAR v1 (SHA-256 + RSA-2048 via Web Crypto API).

## Core Files

- [Web Builder & Signer](index.html): Single-file browser tool implementing custom ZIP parsing/building (`STORE` mode), binary AXML `StringPool` rebuilding, Canvas icon resizing (192x192 PNG), and ASN.1 DER X.509/PKCS#7 JAR signing.
- [Documentation](README.md): Bilingual (Russian/English) user guide and repository overview.
- [License](LICENSE): GNU Affero General Public License v3.0 (AGPL-3.0).

## APK Template Source Code (`template-source/`)

Open source code for compiling the base `template.apk` directly on Android via Termux (`aapt`, `javac`, `d8`, `apksigner`).

- [Android Manifest](template-source/AndroidManifest.xml): Configures package `com.html.app`, `minSdkVersion="21"`, `targetSdkVersion="33"`, internet permissions, cleartext traffic, and hardware acceleration.
- [Main Java Activity](template-source/src/com/html/app/MainActivity.java): Configures `WebView` (`file:///android_asset/www/index.html`), native JS dialogs (`alert`/`confirm`/`prompt`), back-button history navigation, and exposes `window.AndroidBridge` (`getInstalledBrowsers`, `setPreferredBrowser`, `openUrlInBrowser`, `getCurrentWebViewInfo`, `openSystemWebViewPicker`, `setUserAgent`).
- [Termux Build Script](template-source/build.sh): Automated bash script that generates a fallback PNG icon, downloads `android.jar` if missing, compiles resources and Java 8 bytecode, converts to DEX, packages, and signs `template.apk`.
- [Default Template Web Page](template-source/assets/www/index.html): Demo page bundled into the default template APK to test `window.AndroidBridge` features.

## Technical Notes for AI Assistants

- **No External JS Dependencies:** `index.html` uses native browser APIs (`DecompressionStream`, `Web Crypto API`, `Canvas`, `DataView`) and must remain self-contained in a single HTML file.
- **Uncompressed Resources:** `resources.arsc` must always be stored uncompressed (`method: 0` / `STORE`) in the final ZIP/APK to prevent package parsing errors on modern Android versions.
- **Duplicate Archive:** `pro-template-source-v2.zip` in the root directory is a zipped backup of `template-source/`; always reference the unzipped files inside `template-source/` when reading or modifying source code.
